arabic text: Abbas Qatl Hogaye, Mehshar huwa bapaa\nBekas Imaam hogaye, Bhayi huwa juda
english translation text: Abbas has been killed; a Day of Judgement has arisen\nThe Imam is helpless; his brother has been separated

arabic text: Ab khatma hai larayii. Alamdaar chal basaa \nDhore Imaam kehte huwe bhaayi kya huwa.
english translation text: The battle has now ended; the standard-bearer has died \nThe Imam ran towards him, asking: Brother, what has happened?

arabic text: Pohnche jo ghirte parte to dekha ye haalzaar \nShaane kalam sher hai zakhmi para huwa.
english translation text: Stumbling and falling, he reached him and saw this dreadful state \nThe lion's shoulders were severed, and he lay wounded

arabic text: Khun aankh kholkar hame tum dekhte nahi \nAbbas bole teer hai, mawla lagaa huwa.
english translation text: Why do you not open your blood-filled eyes and look at me? \nAbbas replied: Maula, an arrow is lodged in my eye

arabic text: Pyasi Sakina se mei bohot sharmsaar hu \nAfsos hay ke waada, na mujhse wafaa huwa.
english translation text: I am deeply ashamed before thirsty Sakina \nAlas, I could not fulfil my promise

arabic text: Laaye Imaam mashk ko alam khaime gaah me \nChillaaye bibiya ke Alamdaar kya huwa
english translation text: The Imam brought the water-skin and standard back to the tents \nThe ladies cried out: what has happened to the standard-bearer?

arabic text:
Yeh keh rahe the aayi jo do chaar hinch kiya 
Dekha Imaam ne ke, manka jalaa huwa.
Abbas Qatl Hogaye, Mehshar huwa bapaa
Bekas Imaam hogaye, Bhayi huwa juda
english translation text:
After taking two or four final breaths, he was saying this 
The Imam saw that the back of his neck was wounded
Abbas has been killed; a Day of Judgement has arisen
The Imam is helpless; his brother has been separated
